import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long mod = 1000000009;
    static final long INF = mod * mod;
    static final int MAX_N = 1 << 18;
    static Modint[] fact = new Modint[MAX_N];
    static Modint[] factinv = new Modint[MAX_N];
    static PairModint[] dp = new PairModint[501];
    static PairModint[][] dp2 = new PairModint[502][501];

    static class Modint {
        long n;
        Modint() { n = 0; }
        Modint(long m) {
            n = m % mod;
            if (n < 0) n += mod;
        }
        Modint add(Modint b) {
            long res = n + b.n;
            if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
            return new Modint(res);
        }
        Modint sub(Modint b) {
            long res = n - b.n;
            if (res < 0) res += mod;
            return new Modint(res);
        }
        Modint mul(Modint b) {
            return new Modint((n * b.n) % mod);
        }
        Modint pow(long e) {
            if (e == 0) return new Modint(1);
            Modint half = this.mul(this).pow(e / 2);
            if (e % 2 == 1) half = half.mul(this);
            return half;
        }
        Modint div(Modint b) {
            return this.mul(b.inv());
        }
        Modint inv() {
            long a = n;
            long p = mod;
            long b = p, u = 1, v = 0;
            while (b > 0) {
                long t = a / b;
                a -= t * b;
                long tmp = a; a = b; b = tmp;
                u -= t * v;
                tmp = u; u = v; v = tmp;
            }
            u %= p;
            if (u < 0) u += p;
            return new Modint(u);
        }
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (o instanceof Modint) {
                return n == ((Modint)o).n;
            }
            return false;
        }
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(n);
        }
    }

    static class PairModint {
        Modint first, second;
        PairModint(Modint f, Modint s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }

    static long mod_pow(long x, long n) {
        long res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) res = (res * x) % mod;
            x = (x * x) % mod;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init_f() {
        fact[0] = new Modint(1);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N - 1; i++) {
            fact[i + 1] = fact[i].mul(new Modint(i + 1));
        }
        factinv[MAX_N - 1] = new Modint(1).div(fact[MAX_N - 1]);
        for (int i = MAX_N - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            factinv[i] = factinv[i + 1].mul(new Modint(i + 1));
        }
    }

    static Modint comb(int a, int b) {
        if (a < 0 || b < 0 || a < b) return new Modint(0);
        return fact[a].mul(factinv[b]).mul(factinv[a - b]);
    }

    static PairModint mul(PairModint a, PairModint b) {
        return new PairModint(
            a.first.mul(b.first),
            a.second.mul(b.first).add(a.first.mul(b.second))
        );
    }

    static PairModint plu(PairModint a, PairModint b) {
        return new PairModint(
            a.first.add(b.first),
            a.second.add(b.second)
        );
    }

    static void init() {
        init_f();
        dp[0] = new PairModint(new Modint(1), new Modint(0));
        dp[1] = new PairModint(new Modint(2), new Modint(0));
        for (int n = 2; n <= 500; n++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Modint cnt = new Modint(n + 1);
                long sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) sum += Math.abs(j - k);
                Modint sumMod = new Modint(sum);
                PairModint cl = dp[j];
                PairModint cr = dp[n - 1 - j];
                PairModint x = mul(cl, cr);
                x.first = x.first.mul(comb(n - 1, j));
                x.second = x.second.mul(comb(n - 1, j));
                x = mul(x, new PairModint(cnt, sumMod));
                dp[n] = plu(dp[n], x);
            }
        }
    }

    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextLong();
        init();
        for (int i = 0; i < 502; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 501; j++) {
                dp2[i][j] = new PairModint(new Modint(0), new Modint(0));
            }
        }
        dp2[0][0] = new PairModint(new Modint(1), new Modint(0));
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int k = 0;
            while (k <= i) {
                int j = i;
                while (j < n) {
                    int ni = Math.min(j + 2, n);
                    int nk = k + j - i + 1;
                    if (nk <= m) {
                        PairModint x = mul(dp2[i][k], dp[j - i + 1]);
                        x.first = x.first.mul(comb(nk, k));
                        x.second = x.second.mul(comb(nk, k));
                        dp2[ni][nk] = plu(dp2[ni][nk], x);
                    }
                    j++;
                }
                dp2[i + 1][k] = plu(dp2[i + 1][k], dp2[i][k]);
                k++;
            }
            i++;
        }
        Modint ans = dp2[n][m].second;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
